norms.what: A stage skill is model-invocable so the orchestrator can start it, which also lets Claude invoke it on an unrelated task; the run-file guard makes that cost one skill load. Written for the transition-agnostic audit (#34, #41).
After compaction the orchestrator, the oldest skill of the run, is the first to be dropped; re-invoking it restores the run's standing rules. Written for the transition-agnostic audit (#34, #41).

The report file keeps everything the chat leaves out, so the user reads little to decide and loses nothing; discovery findings and the coverage account get sections of their own, since open discovery must show what it found beyond the known traps and what it did not read.
